notes.title: Update Notes For v0.910.02
notes.notes:
CAP2 Release Notes

v0.910.2
[list]
[*] Bug Fixes
   - Ground Vehicle Formations
   - Contrail lighting
   - Ballistic weapon barrel elevation
   - ATACMS ballistic path
   - 3D Audio crackling fix
   - Mission Display Timing
[*] Added Logitech X56 default controls
[/list]
v0.910.0
[list]
[*] Added game/simulation mechanics in preparation for campaign mode such as:
  - missions to protect or interdict convoys of forces or re-arm/re-supply
  - Ground assault formations
  - Artillery Support
  - Airbases with Strike packages taxiing to take-off
  - Drone attacks
[*] Yuma Map Expanded (now South-West USA)
	- Includes Vegas, Nellis AFB, Area51, Tonopah Test Range, Grand Canyon
	- Missions to utilise these areas due in upcoming updates
	- fixed issue with below sea level Salton Sea missing from map
[*] Updated Vehicle AI
	- Convoys
	- Formations
	- Long distance map road/rail routes
	- Airbase taxiing A/C
[*] Improved particle FX
[*] Updated weapon collision and effects
[*] A/C Contrails
[*] Missions
	- Drone Attack
	- KillBox
	- CMR - Defend
	- CMR - Attack
	- Sub Hunt
	- Train Buster
	- Tank Column
[*] New Ground Vehicles
	- HIMARS
	 - ATACMS
	 - GMRLS-ER
	- AAA Gun
	- ZSU-23
	- TRUCKS
[*] New adversary A/C
	- Su-24
	- Shahed Drone
	- Ka-52
[*] New friendly A/C mission assets
	- B-52
	- E-3
	- RC-135
[/list]
Coming Soon
[list]
	[*] OpenXR implementation
	 - 50% complete, coming in subsequent update
	 - Improved performance, compatibility and hand tracking/animation 
	[*] Campaigns
	 - Built-In Campaigns - Small Scale, utilising new mission setup/edit code

	  - ability to specify campaign area, draw starting frontline, manually place units or auto-gen and modify
	[*]  Challenges
	 - Air Dominance
	 - Mach Loop - Timed
	 - Mach Loop - Cleanse
	[*]  A/C
	 - F-14 
	 - Su-34
	 - Tu-95
	[*]  Ground Vehicles
	 - M777 Artillery

	[*]  Updated High Poly, PBR Models
	 - M1A1

	 - M109
	[*]  Airbase Re-arming & Refueling
	[*]  Airbase ground traffic control
	[*]  Wingmen commands

notes.title: v0.900.03 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]v0.900.03[/b]
- Mission Objectives display mode is now On/Off/Auto
  Default is On
- Modified Objectives Display
- Illuminated cockpit controls when they are active mission objective
  i.e. when objective is 'Flaps to VSTOL', flaps switch pulses green
- Fixed multiple issues with weapons training missions
- Dampened yaw & pitch rates (reducing subtle A/C 'wobble' effect)
- Radial Menu
  Added vehicle specific commands
  - i.e. KC767, deploy drogue, deploy boom, arm spoilers, deploy thrust reversers, open cargo door etc
- Re-enabled missing drogues on KC767, fixed tanker behaviour
- Added mouse pointer offset to VR gaze cockpit interaction
  Press left & right mouse button to adjust cockpit item +/-
- Enabled option 'Restrict Mouse to Window'
  press Alt-Tab to quickly disable mouse restriction or disable in options
- Added control inputs:
  - Refuel Probe Toggle (default Ctrl-F)
  - Weapon mode cycle input
    Cycles through weapon specific sub-modes
    i.e. When using AGM-65 Maverick, press this to enable IR TV display
Fixed radar issue where scan width & bars count was overwritten
Fixed 2 potential CTD issues when dogfighting

notes.title: v0.900.02 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]v0.900.02[/b]
- VR Controllers ON/OFF now works correctly
     When off, hands will grip throttle & stick, input will be taken from your standard control inputs
- Added In-Game Help section to lower part of UI
     First section added is VR, describing control modes and relevant input mappings
     Includes directions for how to setup controllers for use with Virtual Desktop
        avoids issue where hands appear in front of face
- Re-enabled dark background in UI controls mapping screens to improve legibility

[b]v0.900.01[/b]
- Updated A/C Audio
- Modified Pilot Pose

[b]v0.900 Start of Microprose series of updates
[/b]- New UI
  including following sections:
    Quick Start
    Free Flight
    Flight Training
    Flight Weapons Training
    Ground Target Range
    A-A Missions
    A-G Missions
    Challenges
    Games
    Mission Progression
    MultiPlayer
  Each section will be enabled in following updates
	
- Visible pilot and pilot hands
  Drawn in regular 3D & VR
  Animated Pilot cockpit Actions
  pilot animations reflect player input

- VR cockpit controls interaction using VR controllers/hands
  3 modes
   free hands - stick control using virtual grab stick throttle
   free hands - stick control using right thumbstick
   locked hands - either hand locked to stick/throttle using gamepad/joystick

-VR
 displays for Radio Comms, Objectives and Notifications

-Multiple control mappings
 Multiple named control sets to easily switch between controllers and also share configurations

-Improved terrain rendering

-Terrain Caching System overhaul
 Improved performance from multi threaded architecture

-Bug Fixes
 SSAO

notes.title: MicroProse Publishing Announcement | Major Game Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Pilots!
I’m delighted to announce that Combat Air Patrol 2 will now be published by the legendary company MicroProse! This partnership marks a significant milestone for my game, and we're both excited about the opportunities this collaboration will bring to enhance your flight simulation experience.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
To celebrate the news we have a big patch for you! Here is all the content in a nifty infographic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12175535/b692f066eabe3426fbb6197b044590da446db61a.jpg[/img]

If you prefer to watch me explain it all just watch the video!

[previewyoutube=OZ5eLKNqGYg;full][/previewyoutube]

Below is a sneak-peek at one of the key updates in today’s patch, showcasing the new cockpit pilot’s visualized actions during play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12175535/4ccdcabf95b59f3c9463aed4328a20f570b4bf80.jpg[/img]

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]

We're also announcing our all-new roadmap for future content coming to the game. Expect exciting new features, missions, and enhancements that will continue to elevate your CAP2 experience via a more consistent patch cadence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12175535/67bb7e56f7831fa953464839f71f00d1184e59bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Developer Updates On Youtube[/h2]

Subscribe to the official [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOHH4BmTPQwwppK52igg_uQ]CAP2 Development Youtube channel[/url] to get the latest updates and early looks at new upcoming patch content and features on the roadmap. The next update is planned for June 24th!

Thank you for being a part of our community and for your continuous support and feedback. I look forward to seeing you in the skies under the banner of MicroProse!

Fly safe, Ed - Sim155

notes.title: v0.815.2 Release
notes.notes:
v0.815.2 has been released today to all channels.

This release addresses several CTD's present in v0.815.1 related to objectives and also updates weapon training missions.

v0.815.2 Release Notes:
- Fixed an objectives related CTD which occurred mostly in training missions
- Updated weapons training missions
- Updated AV-8B engine logic, RPM vs throttle, HUD VTOL RPM display
- Fixed an issue with ingame marker toggling
- Vertical flight aids improved
- Gamepad vibrations are disabled when a menu is shown

We recently updated the CAP2 title video, enjoy :)
https://youtu.be/rPRA8p8eoU8
